messages:
alice: Heads up — looks like pages for app-ingest didn't go out around 10:02 UTC. Prom alerts fired (3x) but incidentbot didn't page. Anyone seeing mobile pages?
incidentbot: I received the alerts but suppressed external paging due to missing heartbeat for pager-integration (:warning:). Suppression reason: heartbeat_last_seen=0.
carol: I didn't get paged. Can someone manually page @sre-jen while we investigate?
alice: Manual page sent to mobile + SMS to @sre-jen.
sre-jen: Got the manual page — joining. What do we know about customer impact?
alice: Error rate spike ~12% for POST /v1/ingest, lots of 5xx returned to callers. No confirmed data loss yet, some retries.
eng-matt: Looking at notify-bridge logs, POST to pager endpoint returning 502. Quick snippet: 
```
2026-03-17T10:02:11Z notify-bridge ERROR: POST https://pager.company/api/v1/page status=502 body="Bad Gateway"
```
incidentbot: Confirming: suppression triggered because integration-worker heartbeat not updated. It prevented outbound paging fanout to oncall.
carol: Restarting integration-worker now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/pager-integration -n notify`
eng-matt: Restart done, healthchecks green. Replaying queued deliveries.
incidentbot: Test alert processed — paging executed to @sre-jen :white_check_mark:
sre-jen: Received test page. Picking this up on bridge: https://call.company/b/meeting-1234
alice: Initial triage: recent envoy filter (edge-auth-rewrite) may be stripping X-Pager-Auth header to pager endpoint. That would cause 502/403 from pager gateway.
eng-matt: Reverting the envoy filter commit a1b2c3 now, redeploying edge.
carol: Edge rollback applied. integration-worker logs now show successful POST 200s: `POST /pager -> 200`
alice: Reprocessing backlog (~18 suppressed alerts) underway.
ops-oncall: Created ticket INC-2026-042 with timeline + customers affected, assigned to eng-matt for root cause.
alice: Customer impact summary for the ticket: ~18 customers saw brief ingestion errors (5xx) for ~3-6 minutes until paging/worker restarted. No data lost; most calls retried successfully. We'll verify downstream metrics for replays.
sre-jen: Adding follow-ups to runbook: - make heartbeat_missing alert visible to #incidents (not just logs) - emit explicit suppressed_page event from incidentbot - add a pager-integration liveness SLO alert (>2m)
eng-matt: Will add CI regression to ensure headers preserved by envoy filters and add an automated smoke test that triggers a synthetic page.
carol: Postmortem owners: eng-matt (root cause & fix), sre-jen (runbook/alerts), alice (customer comms). Draft due EOD tomorrow.
alice: Thanks everyone for the quick manual pages and rollback. Filing immediate ops notes in INC-2026-042 and flagging for CS to contact impacted customers.
eng-matt: Follow-up: I'll instrument integration-worker to report heartbeat timestamps to metrics exporter and create a Grafana alert.
sre-jen: Acknowledged. Will update runbook and ensure oncall rotation receives SMS fallback tests.
alice: Closing the live thread — moving notes into the incident ticket and scheduling postmortem. :thumbsup:
